An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
